item.description: CLINTON - East Feliciana Sheriff's deputies are collaborating with neighboring parishes to crack down on gang violence, and as deputies investigate Saturday's parade shooting, Sheriff Jeff Travis said gangs are creating more work for his department.&nbsp;At Saturday's parade shooting, five people, including a child, were injured.
